messages:
ana: heads up — CI red on my feature branch `feature/metrics-sync` after rebasing onto main. failing test `integrations.test_metrics_pipeline` on shard 3. Anyone free to help triage? :grimacing:
ci-bot: build failed: integ-linux-shard-3 (job 4221). logs: https://ci.redwood/4221 — exit code 1
michael: @ana can you paste the failing stack trace? quick grep for 'AssertionError'
ana: sorry typo — ana: sure, paste log: ```Traceback (most recent call last): File "tests/integrations/test_metrics.py", line 243, in test_metrics_pipeline
    assert len(events) == 42
AssertionError: 37 != 42``` Also saw `KeyError: 'tenant_id'` earlier in the same run.
sam: that test started flaking after last week's DB migration on main — maybe your branch didn't include the migration? Did you rebase properly or skip migrations?
ana: I rebased and ran unit tests locally but not the full integ. Migration file is present `migrations/2024_11_add_tenant_idx.sql` in main — my branch has it too. Strange.
priya: can you run the integration locally with the same shard? `./scripts/run_integ.sh --test integrations.test_metrics_pipeline --shard 3` I can bisect if you want.
ana: starting local run now, will report in ~10m. @eng-oncall can we queue a CI rerun in the meantime? tag: @ci-bot
eng-oncall: queued a rerun for job 4221 (rerun id 4221.1). also assigning @michael to bisect if rerun fails. :eyes:
ci-bot: rerun started 4221.1 — https://ci.redwood/4221.1
ci-bot: rerun 4221.1 finished — failed (same test). logs: https://ci.redwood/4221.1#logs
michael: ok rerun reproduces. please upload the full failing test XML or `/tmp/junit-4221.xml`. I can bisect between main@b7a2 and feature/metrics-sync@c3f4.
ana: uploaded junit: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/4221.1/junit-xml
michael: starting bisect (manual) — will try to narrow to the PR that introduced a change in the metrics pipeline. ETA ~30m.
priya: if it's DB-related, try switching the test DB to `pg_restore` snapshot from last green. I've seen tenant_id issues with the fixtures.
michael: bisect points to commit `d8f2c9` in main — touches `src/metrics/ingest.py` and changes event batching behavior. Suspect reduced batch size trimmed events when sequence reset happened in shard 3.
sam: can we revert that change on main temporarily or add a compatibility fallback? If it's causing prod risk we should revert.
ana: re-running integration locally with `--simulate-batches=large` showed 42 events — so commit `d8f2c9` definitely impacts counts. I'll open a tiny PR to add fallback and ping for quick review.
eng-oncall: created incident tracker item #INC-2024-56 for post-rebase integ regression. tagging for follow-up in today standup.
